title: Le Proces de Nithard -- Bipartite Graph
description: Bipartite similarity graph via two-voice trial structure. Group A (prosecution, skeptical voice) and Group B (defense, faithful voice) form the two partitions. Edges arise only between groups through shared thematic threads reinforced by trial vocabulary. Intra-group edges are suppressed by rotating thread assignments and differentiating sub-topics within each voice.

thread_domains.BONE: Relics, skeletal remains, sarcophagus, archaeology, exhumation
thread_domains.CHRONICLE: Nithard's Historiae, historical record, testimony, Carolingian narrative
thread_domains.CONSPIRACY: Monks' plot, institutional deception, complot, cover-up
thread_domains.FAITH: Belief, religion, devotion, prayer, miracle, sanctity
thread_domains.CARBON: Carbon-14 dating, laboratory analysis, scientific evidence, radiometry
thread_domains.FORGERY: Fabrication, fake inscriptions, counterfeiting, paleographic fraud
thread_domains.INK: Writing, documents, manuscripts, calligraphy, script analysis
thread_domains.JUDGE: Law, verdict, tribunal, justice, deliberation, courtroom
thread_domains.OATH: Sworn testimony, Strasbourg Oaths, perjury, vow
thread_domains.PARCHMENT: Manuscripts, material culture, sheepskin, vellum, codicology
thread_domains.SWORD: Violence, power, Carolingian wars, Fontenoy, military history
thread_domains.TONGUE: Language, vernacular, translation, Old French, proto-Romance

voices.PROSECUTOR: Analytical, skeptical, forensic. Uses vocabulary: evidence, fabrication, fraud, laboratory, dating, inconsistency, motive, verdict.
voices.DEFENDER: Passionate, faithful, reverent. Uses vocabulary: miracle, devotion, relic, sanctity, tradition, witness, grace, heritage.

bipartite_enforcement.thread_level: Each page carries 5 of 12 threads. Pages within the same voice group share at most 2 threads (most share 0-2). Pages across groups share 2-3 threads. The thread overlap provides a scaffold.
bipartite_enforcement.writing_level: Prosecution pages use forensic/skeptical vocabulary throughout. Defense pages use devotional/faithful vocabulary throughout. Cross-group similarity is boosted because both sides discuss the same evidence (bones, chronicle, oaths) using overlapping thematic keywords. Intra-group similarity is suppressed because each page within a group addresses a different specific aspect with distinct sub-vocabulary.
bipartite_enforcement.literary_constraint: No prosecution page may echo another prosecution page's specific argument. No defense page may echo another defense page's specific argument. But every prosecution argument has a defense counterpart addressing the same evidence.

0.title: Opening Statement: The Bones Are Fake

25.title: Opening Statement: The Bones Are Sacred

49.title: Closing Argument: Innocent of All Charges

intra_group_overlap_design: Thread assignments rotate systematically within each group. Most same-group pairs share 1-2 threads. A few pairs share 3 threads but the writing constraint (differentiated sub-topics and voice-specific vocabulary) keeps their cosine similarity below 0.78.
inter_group_overlap_design: Many cross-group pairs share 2-3 threads. The writing constraint (shared trial evidence vocabulary from both perspectives) pushes most 2-overlap pairs and all 3-overlap pairs above the 0.78 threshold.

verification_notes.bipartiteness: Enforced by voice separation: prosecution pages never cross 0.78 with each other due to distinct forensic sub-arguments; defense pages never cross 0.78 with each other due to distinct devotional sub-arguments. Cross-group pairs frequently cross 0.78 because both sides address the same bones, same chronicle, same oaths.
verification_notes.mis_equals_25: MIS = max(|A|,|B|) = 25 for any connected bipartite graph. Each vertex has at least one cross-edge (guaranteed by matched pair sharing 3 threads), so the graph is connected enough.
verification_notes.recommended_validation: Run build_topic_graph.py with k=8, threshold=0.78. Check that all edges connect A-B pairs. Compute MIS and verify = 25.
